# Finch Mortgages

> Finch Mortgages is an independent New Zealand mortgage broker based in Te Atatu South, Auckland. Mortgage adviser Mukhtar Kiyani, who spent 15+ years at ASB, Westpac and BNZ, compares 23 lenders for home loans, first home buyers, refinancing, pre-approval, investment property and self-employed borrowers anywhere in New Zealand. Advice on residential home loans is free: the lender pays a commission when the loan settles. Finch Mortgages (FSP1011125) is an Authorised Body under the Financial Advice Provider licence held by Finsure New Zealand Limited (FSP1005389).

## Key facts

- **Brand:** Finch Mortgages (legal entity: Finch Mortgages Limited). People also search for "Finch Mortgage" and "Finch Mortgages NZ"; the correct name is plural.
- **Adviser:** Mukhtar Kiyani, Director & Financial Adviser (registered financial adviser, FSP1011206)
- **Address:** 17a Marlene Ave, Te Atatu South, Auckland 0610, New Zealand
- **Phone:** 027 343 3293 (+64 27 343 3293)
- **Email:** Mukhtar@finchmortgages.co.nz
- **Hours:** Monday to Friday 9am–6pm, Saturday 10am–2pm
- **Serves:** All of New Zealand, by phone, video or in person
- **Lender panel:** 23 lenders: 6 registered banks, 16 non-bank lenders and 1 credit union
- **Cost to clients:** No fee for residential home loans. Commission is disclosed in writing before a client acts on advice.
- **Disclosure statement:** https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/disclosure.html

## Lender panel (23 lenders)

- **Registered banks:** ANZ, BNZ, Heartland Bank, SBS Bank, The Co-operative Bank, China Construction Bank (New Zealand)
- **Non-bank lenders:** Avanti Finance, Basecorp Finance, CFML, Cressida Capital, DBR Property Financiers, Finbase, First Mortgage Trust, Funding Partners, GEM by Latitude, General Finance, Liberty Financial, Pallas Capital, Pepper Money, Prospa, Southern Cross Partners, Xceda Finance
- **Credit union:** Unity Credit Union
- Full panel with a review of each lender: https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/lenders.html

## Services

- [Home loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/home-loan.html): owner-occupier purchases across New Zealand
- [First home buyer loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/first-home-buyer.html): KiwiSaver first home withdrawal, the Kāinga Ora First Home Loan (5% deposit), family guarantees and low-deposit options
- [Next home buyer](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/next-home-buyer.html): bridging finance and buy-before-you-sell strategies
- [Refinancing](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/refinance.html): rate reviews, lender switches, break fees and cashback costs worked out up front
- [Mortgage pre-approval](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/pre-approval.html): a written pre-approval before you bid at auction or tender
- [Investment property loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/investment-property.html): equity, rental income and debt-to-income (DTI) planning
- [Construction loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/construction-loan.html): progress-payment and turnkey builds
- [Commercial property finance](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/commercial-property.html)
- [Asset finance](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/asset-finance.html): vehicles, plant and equipment
- [Self-employed home loans](https://www.finchmortgages.co.nz/services/self-employed.html): full-doc and low-doc options

- Interest rates and Reserve Bank settings change. Check a page's `dateModified` or the sitemap `lastmod` before quoting figures, and confirm rates with the lender.
